spec.name: Orange Kitchen Veggie Burger
spec.description: A plump sesame veggie burger with stepped golden buns, a toasted soy patty, ruffled lettuce, thick tomato slices and a thin melted cheese layer. Grounded at y=0 with a readable stacked silhouette.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Veggie Burger. Stepped rounded toasted sesame buns; distinctly ruffled lettuce and fillings layered naturally; melted cheese droops at corners. Actual recipe ingredients: bun, soy, lettuce, tomato. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
